components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #121417); color: var(--ink, #121417); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #121417); color: var(--paper, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #1d5fbf); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Datasheet Table
components.description: Hairline table with grey header fill and tabular figures.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.875rem; text-align: start; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 8px 12px; text-align: start; vertical-align: top; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #121417); } .ds-table thead th { background: var(--fill, #eef0f3); font-weight: 800; } .ds-table tbody th { font-weight: 800; } .ds-table td { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Pin
components.description: Pin button with a 28px lead; active is blue and underlined, dimmed is grey.
components.css: .ds-pins { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-pin { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-lead { flex: none; width: 28px; height: 3px; margin-top: 15px; background: var(--ink, #121417); } .ds-pinbtn { appearance: none; border: 0; background: none; padding: 4px 0; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #121417); cursor: pointer; min-height: 24px; } .ds-active .ds-pinbtn { color: var(--accent, #1d5fbf); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-active .ds-lead { background: var(--accent, #1d5fbf); } .ds-dimmed .ds-pinbtn { color: var(--muted, #4a5160); } .ds-dimmed .ds-lead { height: 1px; background: var(--muted, #4a5160); } .ds-pinbtn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #1d5fbf); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The engineer is documented the way a part is: numbered sections, a pin diagram of the stack, measured characteristics, a revision history and ordering information. White paper, near-black ink, one datasheet blue. Hierarchy comes from rule weight and type size only. The page reads as a printed sheet that happens to scroll; it has no dark mode (color-scheme: only light) because a datasheet is paper.

Density is calm and information-first: one reading column (max 920px) beside a quiet numbered index, prose held to 68ch, every number in tabular figures so results can be checked by eye. The one interactive idea is the pin: selecting a technology in the pin diagram recolours every diagram block and case study that uses it, and dims the rest.

The CV is the same world on A4: the same tokens, a 6px blue rule under the header, 9.5pt body, one page.
keyCharacteristics: Five colours in total; blue appears only where something is selected, measured or heads the page.
Rule weight is the hierarchy: 1px hairline, 2px section, 6px header, 1.5px diagram frame, 3px chip.
No cards, no shadows, no gradients, no rounded corners anywhere.
One variable family (Archivo) with width as the second voice: condensed for headings, normal for prose.
Motion is limited to 150ms colour changes and one 900ms bar-length transition.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "this one": selected, measured, or the header. It never fills a surface and never decorates.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Every rule line that carries structure is ink at a stated weight. Grey is for text and fills (the only grey rules are the CV's hairlines between list items, drawn in Fill Grey).

rules.name: The Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number is tabular. Results are bold, never wrap their value (nowrap), and each feature row ends in one checkable figure on its own line.

rules.name: The Width Rule
rules.body: Condensed width is for headings and the name only; prose stays at normal width.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand out, give it a heavier rule or a colour change, never a lift.

dos: Do build hierarchy from rule weight and type size: 1px, 2px, 6px rules; the type ramp above.
Do keep blue to selection, measured results and the header rule.
Do set every number in tabular figures and end each result claim in a checkable figure.
Do keep every corner square and every surface flat.
Do keep a visible 3px blue focus ring with 2px offset, and 44px minimum hit height on buttons.
Do gate hover styles to (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add cards, shadows, gradients, rounded boxes, pills or icon decoration.
Don't add a dark mode or a second accent; the sheet is paper.
Don't use condensed width for prose.
Don't let selection reflow layout; use inset outlines and fixed widths.
Don't open with a greeting hero or a skill-pill cloud.
